title: 第19章 红包子脸第20章 集市
lines: 药膳坊的日子平淡且忙碌。
潘庄河偶尔在西库房整理药材，大部分时间都外出采药了。
科峰城城外的药山方圆千里，再远一点便是凤峦山，凤峦山比药山的范围还大。
潘庄河时常会去凤峦山采摘灵药。
药膳坊里的人都佩服潘庄河的敬业精神，潘庄河还是一名炼药师，但很少炼药，基本上都是以寻找药材为主。
亲自上山挖药这样的活儿，他也从不推脱，别看他年老，身子骨可是强的离谱，一有灵药出世的消息，他总是第一个动身。
曾听肖明清说，有次和潘老上山，遇到黑熊，潘老直接一刀斩了。
坊里其他青壮听闻此事，面面相觑。
“潘老真是劳心劳力啊！”
这一日，药膳坊的学徒和下人们在后院里忙活时，闲聊着说道，“都这么大年纪了，还亲自带人上山找药，真是敬佩。”
“可不是嘛，”
另一个仆人接话道，“多干一点活，还是这么多工钱，少干一点，也是那么多工钱。
“我看就是潘老人善，哎。”
“的确是个善人，去年山林间救的娃子，现在都被他带的白白胖胖的。”
“善人有什么用，还不是下人的命，我们这些人，每次还要被他逼着上山挖药，不知道多危险！”
“就是，他一大把年纪，自己不要命想折腾，别带上我们。
有时候我们干不完活加班，工钱可没多给，还克扣了。”
“扣你钱的是易恩光，和潘庄河有什么关系...”
“潘庄河就是傻，药仙门的仙门令是他拿的，每次都推让出去。
他要是去其他药方就职，待遇高上几倍！”
“这话可别让易恩光听见了，要不然你就别想在这里干了。”
坊里有人敬佩，但自然也有人诋毁潘庄河。
对于上山挖药，大部分门徒都是抗拒的，但是没办法，药膳坊的规矩就是如此，每隔一段时日，必须要山上寻药材，毕竟炼药师需要的药材不管是种类还是树木都是庞大的。
而且药膳坊还有药材出售的生意。
黄子洞便是畏惧上山挖药的人之一。
每次听到药膳坊的管事，要带人进山的消息，黄子洞都会找各种理由避开，生怕自己被拉去干这辛苦活儿。
“黄哥，听说潘爷爷又要上山了，咱们能去吗？”
李骏每次听到潘庄河要上山，显得兴奋不已。
“去？开什么玩笑！”
黄子洞皱着眉头，挥了挥手，“我才不去呢！
上山又累又危险，万一遇上野兽怎么办？你这小脑袋想的都是什么？咦，你这脸上怎么都是红包子，被什么虫子咬了？”
李骏有点生气，小手捏拳说道：“你给我的风铃车蝴蝶没招来，招来了一群蜜蜂，害我在院子里被追的好苦！
我躲在水塘里才躲过去。”
可能是风铃车的花粉袋配错了，你就跟着蜜蜂找蜂蜜好了。”
黄子洞有些尴尬，眼珠子朝天转悠说道。
“你看我蜜蜂都不怕，我可以和他们一起上山！”
“山上的凶兽看到你这样的娃子，一口一个，你就是个累赘，好好待在院子里。”
“可是，我从小在山里长大啊！”
李骏急忙解释道，“我会找路，而且我眼神好，能发现藏在山林里的药材！”
黄子洞瞥了他一眼，笑了笑：“你倒是有志气，不过就算你再贫嘴，潘老先生也不会让你去的。”
content_en:
The days at the Medicinal Food Shop are dull and busy.
Panzhuanghe occasionally sorts out medicinal materials in the west warehouse, but most of the time he goes out to collect medicinal materials.
The Medicine Mountain outside Kefeng City is thousands of miles in diameter, and a little further away is Fengluan Mountain. Fengluan Mountain is even larger than the Medicine Mountain.
Panzhuanghe often goes to Fengluan Mountain to pick elixirs.
Everyone in the medicinal food shop admires Pan Zhuanghe's professionalism. Pan Zhuanghe is also an alchemist, but he rarely refines medicine. He basically focuses on finding medicinal materials.
He never shied away from the task of personally digging for medicine in the mountains. Despite his age, he was extremely strong. Whenever there was news of the emergence of a magical medicine, he was always the first to set off.
I once heard Xiao Mingqing say that once when he and Mr. Pan went up the mountain and encountered a black bear, Mr. Pan killed it with a single blow.
The other young men in the workshop looked at each other in shock when they heard this.
"Mr. Pan is really hardworking!"
On this day, while the apprentices and servants of the medicinal food shop were busy in the backyard, they chatted and said, "At such an old age, I personally lead people to the mountains to find medicine. I really admire it."
"Isn't that right?"
Another servant answered, “Work more and you will still get the same amount of wages, and if you work less, you will still get the same amount of wages.
"I think Mr. Pan is kind, hey. "
"He is indeed a kind man. The children he rescued in the mountains and forests last year are all fat and white now. "
"What's the use of a good man? He's not just a slave to others' lives. We, the people, are forced to go up the mountain to dig for medicine every time. We don't know how dangerous it is! "
"That's right, he is quite old and wants to risk his own life, so don't take us with him.
Sometimes we work overtime without finishing the work, but we are not paid enough and even deducted from our wages. "
"The person who deducted your money is Yi Enguang. What does it have to do with Panzhuanghe..."
"Pan Zhuanghe is stupid, he holds the Immortal Order of Yaoxian Sect, and he gives it away every time.
If he went to work at another pharmacy, his salary would be several times higher! "
"Don't let Yi Enguang hear this, otherwise you won't even think about working here. "
There are people in the community who admire him, but naturally there are also people who slander Panzhuanghe.
Most of the disciples resisted going to the mountains to dig for medicines, but there was no other way. This was the rule of the herbal medicine shop. Every once in a while, they had to go to the mountains to find medicinal materials. After all, the medicinal materials needed by the alchemists were huge in terms of types and trees.
Moreover, the medicinal food shop also sells medicinal materials.
Huang Zidong is one of the people who is afraid of going up the mountain to dig medicine.
Every time he heard the news that the manager of the herbal food shop wanted to take people into the mountains, Huang Zidong would find various reasons to avoid it, for fear that he would be dragged into such hard work.
"Brother Huang, I heard that Grandpa Pan is going up the mountain again, can we go? "
Li Jun seemed very excited every time he heard that Panzhuanghe was going up the mountain.
"Go? What a joke! "
Huang Zidong frowned and waved his hand, "I'm not going!
Going up the mountain is tiring and dangerous. What if you encounter a wild animal? What's going on in your little head? Hey, why are there red bumps all over your face? Are you bitten by some insect? "
Li Jun was a little angry, clenched his fists with his little hands and said: "The wind chime car you gave me didn't attract butterflies, but attracted a swarm of bees, which made me miserable being chased in the yard!
I hid in the pond to escape. "
"ah!
Maybe the pollen bag on the wind chime cart is mismatched, so just follow the bees to find honey. "
Huang Zidong was a little embarrassed, his eyes turned to the sky and he said.
“Look, I’m not afraid of bees, I can go up the mountain with them! "
"When the ferocious beasts on the mountain see a child like you, they bite you one at a time. You are a burden. Stay in the yard." "
“But, I grew up in the mountains! "
Li Jun hurriedly explained, “I can find the way, and I have good eyesight and can find medicinal materials hidden in the mountains and forests! "
Huang Zidong glanced at him and smiled: "You are ambitious, but no matter how talkative you are, Mr. Pan will not let you go. "
